title: Durga Puja 2021 : Saptami - Sandhya Arati | 12 Oct 2021 | Belur Math
description:
The worship of the Divine Mother SRI SRI DURGA will be performed at Belur Math from 12th, 13th and 14th October 2021 respectively, according to the Vishuddha Siddhanta almanac.

Belur Math will remain closed on the following days :
6 October 2021: Mahalaya
9 to 16 October 2021: Durga Puja [Chaturthi to Ekadashi]
